integrity: The proof is self-contained once the defining transition table and published shortest-reset target are fixed. Exact power-automaton checks cover all coprime 2<=p<q<=13, and the symbolic schedule is checked through q<=100.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the n=q Wielandt-type family with 2<=p<q coprime. It does not extend the multiplicity formula to W(n,q,p) with n>q or to other slowly synchronizing families. Originality is supported by targeted literature and database searches, not by an exhaustive proof of absence from all literature.
title: Exact multiplicity of shortest reset words in the Wielandt-type family
